# Bricks & Brains

> Bricks & Brains provides construction supply-chain visibility by connecting procurement, supplier, logistics and embodied-carbon information around shared material records.

Bricks & Brains is a Singapore-based construction technology company. Its platform combines a Construction Supply Chain Digital Twin, a knowledge graph, construction-focused language intelligence and specialised AI agents. The agents draft, analyse, monitor and coordinate work while commercial, contractual, technical and regulatory decisions remain behind human approval gates.

Canonical website: https://www.bricks-brains.com

## Platform

- [Construction Supply Chain Visibility](https://www.bricks-brains.com/): Overview of the platform, live use cases and pilot approach.
- [B2 Intelligence](https://www.bricks-brains.com/b2-intelligence): The shared intelligence layer connecting project, procurement, supplier, logistics and site information.
- [B2 Agents](https://www.bricks-brains.com/b2-agents): Specialised agent teams for procurement, material logistics and embodied carbon, with human approval gates.
- [Material Data Layer](https://www.bricks-brains.com/material-data-layer): How BIM, BOQs, ERP, supplier and project information connect to a shared operational material state.
- [B2 Carbon](https://www.bricks-brains.com/b2-carbon): Material-level embodied-carbon intelligence connected to construction procurement, suppliers and delivery records.
- [Join a Pilot](https://www.bricks-brains.com/pilot): Apply to evaluate Bricks & Brains on a focused project or material package.
- [Contact](https://www.bricks-brains.com/contact-us): Contact information and company details.

## Live Use Cases

- [Critical Material Delay](https://www.bricks-brains.com/use-cases/critical-material-delay): Connect a supplier milestone change to its purchase order, shipment and programme dependency, then evaluate recovery options.
- [Lower-Carbon Procurement](https://www.bricks-brains.com/use-cases/lower-carbon-procurement): Compare cost, lead time, product carbon data and transport within the procurement decision.
- [Material Substitution](https://www.bricks-brains.com/use-cases/material-substitution): Assess a proposed substitute across specification, commercial, delivery and embodied-carbon impacts before approval.

## Agent Teams

- [Procurement Agents](https://www.bricks-brains.com/agents/procurement): Draft RFQs, structure supplier quotations, compare bids and prepare award recommendations.
- [Logistics Agents](https://www.bricks-brains.com/agents/logistics): Monitor supplier commitments and delivery milestones, surface disruption risk and coordinate exceptions.
- [B2 Carbon Agents](https://www.bricks-brains.com/agents/scope3): Match materials to EPDs or approved factors, calculate carbon and support lower-carbon procurement comparisons.
